body: Isn't a HashMap default initialized? I don't recall us doing explicit `memnew` for HashMaps.
Just for my curiosity: We don't usually do explicit `this->` dereference, is this necessary here or just a stylistic choice?
We are using a lot of static `HashMap`s, so `memnew` is not necessary. Also, nothing is freeing it, so map will leak.
Check can be `unlikely(parse_message_handlers.is_empty())`, if it was the reason to use pointer.
Sounds good – I will change it and use is_empty

In order to call a pointer to a member function, we need to provide it the object we wish to call the function on. I believe there are other examples of this in Godot code, which I can provide tomorrow, when I am in front of my computer. 

Thank you for the review!

@akien-mga I found a few examples, such as this:
